Release train

Three trains a week, each cut by one owner and rolled back by anyone.

Who cuts what

Train Owner Cut
Web Priya Mon
API Tomás Wed
Mobile Noor Fri

The pipeline

# one stage per gate
stages: [build, canary, ship]
canary: "5% for 2h"

The canary holds until its error rate settles.

Rolling back

git revert --no-edit HEAD
git push origin main

Anyone on call may revert; the train owner follows up.
